## About

Senior software engineer with 6+ years of experience building web, mobile, and data platforms
across GCP and AWS, mostly in highly regulated domains: healthcare, genomics pipelines, EHR systems,
and enterprise retail.

I like working close to the product and the customer, turning ambiguous problems into scalable,
reliable software that is maintainable, secure, and built for real-world use. I use AI tools and
agentic workflows to move faster while staying hands-on with system design, edge cases, and code quality.

## What I bring

- **System design & architecture**: Service boundaries, integrations, data modeling and scalability trade-offs for clinical and genomics data platforms.
- **Cloud platform & production reliability**: GCP (GKE, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Logs Explorer) and AWS, IaC, CI/CD, and production support for a genomics reporting pipeline.

- **Technical leadership & mentorship**
